admin.subtitle: Data exports, deletion requests and retention

mode.label: Erasure mode
mode.hintAnonymize: Name and email are replaced, sign-in methods are removed and the account is disabled. Tickets and messages stay.
mode.hintRedact: Also replaces the messages they wrote with [redacted] and deletes their attachments and the custom-field values of their tickets.

requests.loadFailed: The privacy requests could not be loaded.

erase.title: Erase personal data
erase.intro: This is irreversible. Tickets stay for business records, but the person can no longer be identified from this account.
erase.confirm: I understand that this cannot be undone
erase.done: Personal data erased: {messages} messages redacted, {attachments} attachments deleted

export.includeInternal: Include internal notes and staff-only fields
export.queued: Export requested. An email is sent when it is ready.

settings.retentionHint: Applied once a day. Use the preview to see what the next run would change.
settings.autoApproveDaysHint: 0 means an administrator decides every request
settings.policyVersionHint: Stored with every consent, for example the policy date

preview.title: Dry run
preview.intro: What the retention job would process right now with the values above (nothing is changed).

my.title: My data
my.intro: Download a copy of your personal data or ask us to delete your account.
my.introStaff: Download a copy of the personal data this help desk holds about you.
my.exportBody: We prepare a ZIP file with your profile, your tickets and messages, your attachments and your consent records. You get an email when it is ready; the file can be downloaded for {days} days.
my.empty: You have not made any requests yet.
my.deletionBody: An administrator reviews the request. After deletion you can no longer sign in, and your name and email are removed from our records.
my.deletionPending: Your deletion request is waiting for review.
my.confirm: I understand that my account will be deleted and that this cannot be undone

consent.accept: I have read and accept the privacy policy
